_source: Dubai Properties page for Bay Square, read 17 September 2026 (manifest: data/media/_sources/bay_square.json).
_assets_from: 5 images published openly. These are PHOTOGRAPHS of a completed development, not renders - the note says so rather than repeating the render wording used for off-plan buildings.
strapline: Dubai Properties, on the Dubai Canal in Business Bay
_override_note: Dubai Properties names these files only Bay-Square1..4, so nothing can be captioned as a named room from the filename. I looked at them: the hero is the cluster seen across the water, and the two supporting pictures are the colonnade and a shopfront on it. They are captioned as what they are rather than given room names they do not have.
image_note: Images are published by Dubai Properties, the developer of Bay Square, and are reproduced here for a buyer considering the development. They are photographs of the completed buildings rather than computer renders.
caveats: Bay Square is a mixed-use cluster and most of its floorspace is offices and retail rather than homes, so the apartment figures above describe a small part of what was built. No apartment layouts are published; ask and we will request the plan for a specific unit.
